purpose: complete long/cash portfolio ledger, not fixed-horizon events
user_exit_confirmation: 不必等到70，持有后跌破10日线就卖
entry_timing: default: allow MA10 confirmation after V recovered30; strict same-day variant reported separately; user acknowledged 好的
ma_definition: simple arithmetic mean of latest10 continuous-adjusted closes, includes signal day

strategies.BUY_HOLD: cash start; buy at first permitted next quote open; hold to terminal liquidation estimate
strategies.MA10_ONLY: flat and close>MA10 buys next quote open; held and close<MA10 sells next quote open; equality keeps current state
strategies.COMBO_WAIT: observe V<30 (current/previous close), arm while flat; V>=30 and close>MA10 buys next quote open, allowing later MA confirmation; consume setup only on filled buy; no expiry parameter
strategies.COMBO_SAME: buy only on same-day V previous<30<=current and close>MA10; sell same MA10 break as main

sell_for_both_combo_variants: if holding and continuous close<MA10, sell next available quote open regardless V; never wait for70
cycle_after_exit: ignore old lows during holding; on exit-confirmation close arm only if V<30; after flat, new observed low/current or prior close can arm again
start: all strategies start trading cash=1, no inherited positions/orders; first signal at first eligible session close; prior-bar V can identify fresh rebound on that first session
segment_policy: per ETF first available quote on/after start with >=14 closes. Historical holdout is primary; full history/development are secondary, not untouched OOS. Do not annualize segments shorter than365 days.
cost_math: side rate=roundtrip/2; buy shares=trading_cash/(open*(1+side)); sell receives shares*price*(1-side); all baselines pay both ends
dividends: economic entitlement at ex-date into segregated dividend cash/receivable; never reinvest into later buys, no payment-date liquidity assumed
shares: adjust held shares using cumulative share-factor ratio before next quote open; raw OHLC for fills/marks
price_for_signals: raw_close*s+u as already-audited source adjusted_close; not independently matched to each ETF App qfq at every corporate action
quote_gaps: next available per-ETF quote is execution session, not synthetic filled prices; zero-volume quote cancels that pending execution and reevaluates at close. For aggregated NAV only, forward-fill last mark on missing dates.
terminal: mark/liquidate remaining shares at final close with estimated side cost; label forced_end separately, do not count it as rule-completed trade
primary_comparator: COMBO_WAIT vs MA10_ONLY, net CAGR and closing-NAV max drawdown, time/capital exposure; BUY_HOLD secondary
aggregation: 9 independent equal-initial-capital subaccounts, no cross-ETF rebalancing; aggregate only primary common period. Also show per-ETF results and all cost cases.

bootstrap.method: resample nonoverlapping joint date blocks of realized aggregate paired log returns; scale by observed sessions/calendar-year; no resimulated signal/price concatenation

historical_return_support_criterion: aggregate net CAGR difference>0, paired date-block CI low>0, majority of same ETFs have positive CAGR difference; never claim future confirmed advantage from this retrospective data
risk_advantage: report drawdown/time-exposure tradeoff separately, not relabel lower exposure as superior returns

eligible_symbols.label: 科创50
eligible_symbols.group: A股成长，已见过同指数样本

inputs.source_exclusion: 510500 remains excluded for604 adjustment mismatches; no added replacements

limitations: known recent-market and previous indicator work; not genuinely unseen
theoretical daily open/close fills, no orderbook/lot/minimum-fee/limit-queue model
closing-NAV drawdown, not intraday true maximum drawdown
dividends segregated without reinvestment; no actual distribution payment-date ledger
